key.name: max-width
key.description: Width of the lyrics label in pixels before the text is ellipsized.

key.name: sync-offset
key.description: Positive values show each line earlier, negative values later.

key.name: tick-interval
key.description: How often the displayed line is re-evaluated against the playback position.

key.name: hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide when there is nothing to show
key.description: Remove the label from the panel when Spotify is closed, paused or no lyrics were found.

key.name: fallback-to-title
key.summary: Show artist and title when no lyrics exist
key.description: If LRCLIB has no synced lyrics for the track, display "Artist — Title" instead.

key.name: show-unsynced
key.description: When only unsynced lyrics are available, spread them evenly across the track duration.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which box of the top bar the lyrics label sits in: left, centre or right.
